svg.text: In the circle operation's flat coordinate, only the one-loop shape is a straight line
RG time t = log k (toward the UV →)
one loop: slope exactly −(d − 2) = −2 all the way
the others start at slope −2 and bend to −θ at the wall
two loops in 2 + ε, taken at ε = 2
A circle-op flow (a o_k b = a + b + kab in u = 1/g) is exactly a flat line on the right. Flat at 2 needs θ = d − 2 at the wall. Checks P1–P4, T2.
Known: the four β functions (Bonanno–Reuter 2000; Litim 2004 / Reuter–Saueressig; Aida–Kitazawa 1997). The flat-coordinate test is ours.
